content.text: This is really common at 5, and it usually fades fast once the new routine is predictable. Tonight, tell Milo calmly before bed what the plan is. If he wakes and comes in, walk him back to his own bed with a quick hug and the same short line each time, like "You're safe, this is your bed, see you in the morning." Keep it boring and don't negotiate. A sticker chart for staying in his own bed can help as a reward.
